warning: Not Apple-silicon or production MAVEB timing; RSS includes process/vector overhead and should be used only comparatively.
interpretation: Hash buckets prioritize dirty-region lookup latency but carry substantially higher memory/pointer overhead in this probe.
Sorted compact storage roughly halves peak RSS and builds faster here, but binary range queries are materially slower.
The two selected counts differ because each layout samples 1% of its occupied-cell ordering independently; this probe compares structure cost, not selected-set equivalence.
Production evaluation should add Morton-sorted ranges with a compact region directory, flat/open-addressing hash, clustered real scenes, and incremental relocation cost.
decision: DO NOT FREEZE DATA STRUCTURE. Preserve GaussianSpatialIndex abstraction; benchmark flat hash / compact sorted-Morton designs on M2 Pro before claiming locality efficiency.
